insights.raw_text: I tried finding a picture of a handwritten recipe from 2 years ago. I remembered it was written on blue paper on my kitchen counter, but searching 'recipe' gives me 500 random food photos and zero document results.
insights.user_search_formulation: broad categorical noun ('recipe') without visual or scene descriptors
insights.opportunity_area: Improve multimodal intent disambiguation so generic terms like 'recipe' can rank handwritten documents and scene cues (e.g., paper, counter) alongside food imagery.

insights.raw_text: Search is terrible when you don't know the date. I wanted to show my friend a photo of a cafe we went to right after graduation in Goa. I typed 'Goa cafe' and got hundreds of results from 3 different trips because I couldn't filter by 'summer 2022'.
insights.opportunity_area: Surface natural-language temporal filters (e.g., 'summer 2022') and trip/event groupings immediately after location queries to disambiguate repeat visits.

insights.raw_text: I took a screenshot of a medicine prescription last year when I was sick with flu. I can't remember the brand name, so I typed 'medicine', but Google Photos didn't pick up the handwritten text on the bottle label.
insights.user_search_formulation: single generic tag ('medicine') without label or prescription text
insights.opportunity_area: Strengthen OCR and handwriting retrieval on screenshots so partial health-related queries match visible label and prescription text even when brand names are unknown.
